boards.title: Discover boards
boards.description: Public Content Rewards discover pages to scrape. Combined and deduplicated.

campaignUrls.title: Specific campaign URLs or IDs
campaignUrls.description: Optional Content Rewards campaign links or UUIDs. When set, results are limited to these campaigns (details are fetched if they are not on Discover).

includeDetails.title: Enrich with campaign detail pages
includeDetails.description: Fetch each campaign's public detail page for per-platform payouts, status and content types. Slower; still no login.

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Keep campaigns whose title, brand, handle, category or description contains this text.

platforms.title: Platforms
platforms.description: Keep campaigns that allow at least one of these platforms.

category.title: Category contains
category.description: Optional category filter (e.g. Music, Sports, Entertainment).

minBudgetLeft.title: Minimum budget left (USD)
minBudgetLeft.description: Drop campaigns with less remaining budget than this.

openOnly.title: Open campaigns only
openOnly.description: Hide campaigns that require an application.

status.title: Status (detail pages)
status.description: Optional status filter, e.g. active. Most useful with detail enrichment.

maxItems.title: Max campaigns in total
maxItems.description: Hard cap on campaigns returned (and charged) in this run.
